integrity: The proof reduces stable color equality to rooted universal-cover isomorphism and then shows that every automorphism of the decorated-line universal cover of a unicyclic graph descends to an automorphism of the finite graph. A standalone finite checker independently compares stable partitions with automorphism orbits on all connected Graph Atlas representatives of cycle rank at most one through seven vertices.
scientific limitations: The theorem concerns connected graphs of cyclomatic number at most one; disconnected pseudoforests can fail the conclusion.
The result is about orbit recovery by the stable color partition, not amenability or graph identification.
The cycle-rank-two example shows only that the class-wide guarantee is sharp, not that all bicyclic graphs fail refinability.
The finite Graph Atlas computation is a consistency check and does not replace the all-order proof.
title: Color refinement recovers automorphism orbits on every connected graph of cycle rank at most one
